hero.description: Miami is the most Latin city in the USA — and during the 2026 World Cup, it will feel like a global party. Hard Rock Stadium is right at home amid one of the most passionate football fan bases in North America.

stadium.name: Hard Rock Stadium
stadium.address: 347 Don Shula Dr, Miami Gardens, FL 33056
stadium.transport: No direct rail to Hard Rock Stadium. Shuttle buses run from Downtown Miami and the Metrorail Okeechobee station. Rideshare is the most popular option — plan for 30-40 minutes from South Beach.

bars.name: The Wharf Miami
bars.address: 114 SW North River Dr, Miami, FL

transport.summary: Miami is spread out and transit is limited outside Downtown. Rideshare and rental cars are king, but game-day shuttles are expected to run on match days.
tips: Book Ubers/Lyfts in advance using scheduled rides — surges after matches are extreme
Metrorail Okeechobee station connects to game-day stadium shuttles
Stay in Brickell or Downtown for the best stadium access
South Beach to stadium is 35-45 minutes — budget extra time on match days

fan_zones.name: Bayfront Park Fan Hub
fan_zones.description: A major fan gathering area expected at Bayfront Park during the tournament, featuring the stunning Biscayne Bay waterfront, big screens, live DJ sets, and food trucks. Check local listings for confirmed details.

fan_zones.name: Little Havana Fan Block
fan_zones.description: Miami's vibrant Latin quarter transforms into a street-long watch party for every match. Dominoes, live salsa, and the best Cuban food in the city.

quick_facts.fan_hub_status: Major public viewing areas expected; confirm local schedules before match day

weather.june: Hot and humid, with highs around the upper 80s Fahrenheit and frequent afternoon storms.
weather.july: Very warm, humid, and storm-prone; evenings stay warm and outdoor plans need weather flexibility.
packing_tips: Pack breathable clothes, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a refillable water bottle
Bring a light rain shell or compact umbrella for afternoon storms
Plan indoor breaks between outdoor fan events and evening watch parties

airports.name: Miami International Airport
airports.distance_to_stadium: Roughly 15-20 miles from Hard Rock Stadium depending on route
transfer_options: Rideshare or taxi is usually the simplest airport-to-hotel option
Metrorail connects the airport area with Downtown and Brickell
Rental cars make sense if you plan beach, Fort Lauderdale, or day-trip driving
airports.notes: Best airport for Brickell, Downtown, Coral Gables, Little Havana, and most Miami hotel stays.

airports.name: Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport

transfer_options: Rideshare is straightforward but can surge after major arrivals

Good alternate airport for fans staying north of Miami
airports.notes: A useful backup airport for cheaper flights or stays in Aventura, Hollywood, Fort Lauderdale, or north Miami-Dade.
